nodes.description: Immutable-in-practice constant uint256 PERIOD = 30 minutes, the minimum elapsed time between oracle updates
immutable address of the ICCFactory used to resolve pairs and sort tokens
private mapping(address => Observation) storing cumulative prices, timestamps and TWAP averages per pair
Oracle constructor: validates _factory != address(0) and assigns the immutable factory
external view returning the stored observation for the pair of tokenA/tokenB
public override that inits or refreshes the observation of a pair, computing TWAP averages; performs unchecked timestamp/cumulative subtractions and a division by timeElapsed
external override that resolves the pair for tokenA/tokenB via the factory and delegates to updatePair
external view TWAP quote: reads the pair observation and multiplies the stored average price by amountIn
block.timestamp (reduced to uint32 via currentBlockTimestamp) drives all timing decisions in the oracle
blockTimestamp - observation.blockTimestampLast, an unchecked subtraction where overflow/underflow is intentionally desired
price0Cumulative/price1Cumulative - observation.price*CumulativeLast, unchecked cumulative-price subtraction wrapped before division
(priceCumulativeDelta) / timeElapsed division producing the average price; relies on the earlier timeElapsed < PERIOD guard, no SafeMath division
FixedPoint.mul in consult: checked uint multiplication of a uq112x112 average by amountIn, reverts on overflow
constructor parameter _factory
getObservation parameter tokenA
getObservation parameter tokenB
updatePair parameter pair, the pair address to initialize/update
update parameter tokenA
update parameter tokenB
consult parameter tokenIn
consult parameter amountIn, the quote input amount
consult parameter tokenOut
storage pointer Observation observation = pairObservations[pair] in updatePair
uint32 timeElapsed in updatePair, result of blockTimestamp - observation.blockTimestampLast
uint price0Cumulative in updatePair returned by CCOracleLibrary.currentCumulativePrices
uint price1Cumulative in updatePair returned by CCOracleLibrary.currentCumulativePrices
uint32 blockTimestamp in updatePair derived from block.timestamp
address pair resolved through factory.getPair in getObservation
address pair resolved through factory.pairFor in consult
